KIND.description: What kind of place it is: a café, a wine bar, a record shop. Who a place is, not what it serves this season.

HOURS.description: When it is open: days and times. New hours replace old ones.

VIBE.description: What it is like to be there at some time: loud, quiet, cosy, crowded, good for working. Several can be true at once.

ORDER.description: Something worth ordering or doing there, including a pop-up or a special, with its end date when one was said.

vibe.label: What it is like to be there

charter:
# What we keep about places

Keep what changes the next visit: what kind of place it is, when it is open, what it is like, and what is worth ordering. Keep only what the note says about places on the list. A note that only mentions a visit keeps nothing.
